test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the compound interest on Rs. 25,000 at the rate of 6% per annum in 2 years?
solution:
Given:

Principal amount = Rs. 25000

Rate of interest = 6%

Time = 2 years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

The compound interest incurred

⇒ 25000 (1 + 6/100)² - 25000

⇒ 28090 - 25000

⇒ 3090

**∴ The compound interest on Rs. 25,000 at the rate of 6% per annum in 2 years will be 3090.**
